add_prog_clusters = function(pro_clusters, cds, pfx ="b"){
    print("Adding progenitor clusters -> prog_clusters")
    names(pro_clusters) = gsub("day0.subjectS6","asc.day0",names(pro_clusters))
    head(pro_clusters[colnames(cds)])
    cds$progen_clusters = pro_clusters[colnames(cds)]
    print(table(cds$progen_clusters, useNA="ifany"))
    
    print("Filling NAs with initial clusters -> if_progen_cluster")
    cds$if_progen_cluster = paste0(pfx,cds$initial_clusters)
    cds$if_progen_cluster[!is.na(cds$progen_clusters)] =         
        paste0("p",cds$progen_clusters[!is.na(cds$progen_clusters)])
    print(table(cds$if_progen_cluster, useNA="ifany"))
    
    cat("\nFilling NAs with time -> time.prog_clusters\n")
    cds$time.progen_clusters = cds$time
    cds$time.progen_clusters[!is.na(cds$progen_clusters)] =  
        paste0("p",cds$progen_clusters[!is.na(cds$progen_clusters)])
    print(table(cds$time.progen_clusters))
    return(cds)
}

}

# total
add_pseudotime = function(seurat, velocity, condition_col="velocity"){
    pseudotime_vals <- rep(NA, length = length(colnames(seurat)))
    names(pseudotime_vals) <- colnames(seurat)
    existing_cells <- intersect(colnames(seurat), colnames(velocity))
    pseudotime_vals[existing_cells] <- colData(velocity)[existing_cells,'velocity_pseudotime']
    print(summary(pseudotime_vals))
    seurat$velocity_pseudotime <- pseudotime_vals
    seurat$pscondition = condition_col
    return(seurat)
}
